subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Despite the professor's best efforts to explain the complex theory, it took me a while to __decipher__ the meaning of the text.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Interpret**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Decipher **means to decode or unravel something that is difficult to understand. (किसी ऐसी चीज़ को डिकोड करना या सुलझाना जिसे समझना मुश्किल हो)

 
 
• **Example**: *The detective tried to decipher the cryptic message left at the crime scene.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Interpret **means to explain the meaning of something. (किसी बात का अर्थ समझाना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The teacher asked the students to interpret the poem and share their understanding with the class.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Predict **means to make an educated guess about something that may happen in the future. (भविष्य में होने वाली किसी चीज़ के बारे में शिक्षित अनुमान लगाना)
 
• **Conceal **means to hide or keep something secret. (किसी बात को छिपाना या गुप्त रखना)
 
• **Foresee **means to anticipate or predict something that may happen in the future. (भविष्य में घटित होने वाली किसी बात का पूर्वानुमान या भविष्यवाणी करना)
